evidence.why: Transaction success/failure is decided entirely on-device using a mock local function instead of a real server/payment-provider call, so the trusted payment decision lives in the client artifact.
No actual network call to an authenticated backend or payment provider is made; all card validation and transaction outcome logic is client-side.

other_classes_observed: Raw card number/CVV handled directly in client state without PCI-compliant tokenization (not in scope)
